diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 98aebbf..580c273 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -252,3 +252,16 @@ Privacy information can be found at https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/
 
 Microsoft and any contributors reserve all other rights, whether under their respective copyrights, patents,
 or trademarks, whether by implication, estoppel, or otherwise.
+## Dependency Management
+
+This project pins critical transitive dependencies to ensure reproducible installations.
+The `constraints.txt` file locks `protobuf` to version **5.29.3** and restricts `numpy` to versions **<2.0.0**.
+When installing the package, pip will automatically apply these constraints:
+
+```bash
+pip install -e . -c constraints.txt
+```
+
+If you need to update these pins, modify `constraints.txt` and the corresponding entries in
+`pyproject.toml`, then run the full test suite to verify compatibility.
+
diff --git a/constraints.txt b/constraints.txt
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fcea7a3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/constraints.txt
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+protobuf==5.29.3
+numpy<2.0.0
diff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml
index 3cd32f1..4bf9e34 100644
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -1,6 +1,11 @@
 [metadata]
 license_file = "LICENSE"
 description-file = "README.md"
+[build-system]
+requires = ["setuptools>=42", "wheel"]
+build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
+constraints = ["-c constraints.txt"]
+
 
 
 [tool.pytest.ini_options]
@@ -104,3 +109,10 @@ warn_unused_ignores = true
 disallow_incomplete_defs = true
 disallow_untyped_decorators = true
 disallow_any_unimported = true
+
+[project]
+dependencies = [
+    "protobuf==5.29.3",
+    "numpy<2.0.0",
+]
+
diff --git a/test/test_dependency_pin.py b/test/test_dependency_pin.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6ed304b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/test_dependency_pin.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import importlib
+import pkg_resources
+
+def _version_satisfies(version, spec):
+    return pkg_resources.parse_version(version) in pkg_resources.Requirement.parse(spec).specifier
+
+def test_dependency_versions():
+    # Verify protobuf version
+    protobuf = importlib.import_module("protobuf")
+    assert protobuf.__version__ == "5.29.3", f"Expected protobuf==5.29.3, got {protobuf.__version__}"
+
+    # Verify numpy version is <2.0.0
+    numpy = importlib.import_module("numpy")
+    assert _version_satisfies(numpy.__version__, "numpy<2.0.0"), (
+        f"Expected numpy<2.0.0, got {numpy.__version__}"
+    )
